channel.title: 3ABN Christmas Special
channel.desc: Enter the Christmas season with a gentle, worship-filled musical journey led by Tim Parton and Layke Jones. From treasured hymns like The First Noel, O Come O Come Emmanuel, and Silent Night to powerful contemporary pieces including Emmanuel (Hallowed Manger Ground) and Breath of Heaven, each song points to the miracle of Christ's coming. A beautiful celebration of peace, hope, and God's unfailing love.
